subject: Onboarding paperwork for Aurelia Tech — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessors, PO instructions
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aureliatech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding paperwork for Aurelia Tech — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessors, PO instructions

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference. Procurement at Aurelia asked us to collect a few items to complete vendor activation on your side so that they can issue the PO: DPA (signed), current SOC 2 report (or secure read-only link), and a full subprocessor list. They also want the billing contact and the exact legal entity name for the PO.

Can you: 
- Confirm the legal entity name you want on the PO
- Attach a signed DPA (or point me to the DocuSign packet)
- Share a SOC 2 link or PDF (we can accept a guarded link)
- Attach the subprocessor list (CSV or spreadsheet)
- Confirm billing email and purchase order routing (procure@aureliatech.com or other)

I copied Ben (commercial ops) and Marissa (legal intake) to speed review on our end. If easier, a single zip with the items works fine.

Thanks — aim is to get Aurelia live this month so they can start the reserved capacity seat.

Best,
Logan
Director, Platform Sales
Redwood Inference

---
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aureliatech.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@aureliatech.com
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 15:12:21 -0500
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork for Aurelia Tech — DPA, SOC 2, subprocessors, PO instructions

Hi Logan — thanks, looping in procurement. See attachments and links below.

Attachments: Aurelia_DPA_signed.pdf, SOC2_Report_2024.pdf, subprocessors_list.csv

Notes:
- Legal entity for PO: Aurelia Tech, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789)
- Billing contact: billing@aureliatech.com (Jane Chang)
- Procurement (procure@aureliatech.com) will issue PO once DPA and SOC2 receipt confirmed

SOC 2 link (access-controlled): https://secure-hosting.example.com/soc2/aurelia-2024
DocuSign envelope for DPA: https://docusign.com/rooms/abc123

Let me know if you need additional attestations — happy to introduce our security contact.

—Emma
VP, Vendor Operations
Aurelia Tech

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork for Aurelia Tech — quick review steps

Looping legal intake (Marissa) and ops. Quick checklist for us: 
1) Verify DPA signature block matches legal entity (Aurelia Tech, Inc.)
2) Confirm SOC 2 coverage period and that there are no outstanding exceptions
3) Validate subprocessors list against our approved subprocessor policy (if any unknown names, flag for assessment)
4) Confirm billing email matches PO workflow and that procure@aureliatech.com is an approved sender for automated PO emails

Marissa — can you take a look at the DPA and SOC2 link and advise on whether we need a security attestation or a confidentiality rider?

Ben
Commercial Operations Manager

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aureliatech.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 17:03:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork for Aurelia Tech — legal intake notes

Thanks — I pulled the DPA and SOC2. Quick findings: 
- DPA: Signed and executed via DocuSign (signature and dates present). Legal entity matches. Recommend we store the signed PDF in vendor records.
- SOC 2: Report is a Type II for 2024; there is one minor control exception noted for change management (low severity). I'll flag that as an action item (sec-review ticket).
- Subprocessors CSV: contains three cloud providers and one analytics vendor. One entry (analytics-svc.example) is not on our current approved list — need security to assess whether that's categorized as a high-risk subprocessor.

Action items: 
- Logan: confirm PO recipient and expected PO number format with Aurelia procurement
- Ben: create vendor record and attach the three artifacts to the onboarding folder
- Marissa: open a security review ticket for analytics-svc.example and note the SOC2 exception

I'll prepare a short intake note that we can attach to the vendor record and share with procurement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

---
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@aureliatech.com>, procure@aureliatech.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2025 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding paperwork for Aurelia Tech — PO routing and next steps

Thanks, Emma — procurement team at Aurelia, quick question on PO routing: will the PO be issued to "Aurelia Tech, Inc." with remit-to address 100 Market St, Suite 400? Also, do you use PO numbers in the format AUR-YYYY-####? If so, can you confirm the first PO expected this month so we can seed the billing workflow.

We will: 
- Create vendor record and attach DPA, SOC2, subprocessors (Ben)
- Open security review for analytics vendor (Marissa)
- Expect PO and will trigger account activation once we receive the PO number and confirm billing contact receipt (billing@aureliatech.com)

If procurement would prefer a consolidated invoice/one-time setup fee to be invoiced separately, we can accommodate — please advise.

Best,
Logan

[Attachment stubs: Aurelia_DPA_signed.pdf (signed DPA), SOC2_Report_2024.pdf (redacted copy), subprocessors_list.csv (vendor,service,type)]
